description:
The carriers’ own send-by dates for delivery by the 2026 winter holidays: USPS (Ground Advantage, Priority Mail, Priority Mail Express; delivery by Dec 25) and FedEx (Ground Economy, Ground and Home Delivery by days in transit, Express Saver, 2Day, Overnight; delivery by Dec 24), each marked on_track or too_late for today in New York, with the page each date was read from. UPS publishes no fixed dates, and the answer says so. Contiguous US only; never a guarantee and never an SMKlog estimate. No carrier call, no quote allowance.

Parameter rules:
- No parameters.
- After Dec 24, 2026 the answer says the season is over and lists no dates.
- For a real lane and service, get_parcel_quote returns each service’s delivery estimate.
name: get_holiday_shipping_deadlines
